    Within the context of a single ITS, it is possible to use an xarray to

bic_trace_step.reason: The commit introduces the vulnerable `vgic_its_invalidate_cache()` function. In lines 670-673, it iterates over the `translation_cache` using `xa_for_each` and calls `xa_erase(&its->translation_cache, idx)` followed by `vgic_put_irq(kvm, irq)`. Because it drops the reference of the iterated `irq` instead of the pointer returned by `xa_erase()`, concurrent execution paths can erase the same entry and drop the reference to the same IRQ multiple times.
